def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = [v for v in grid[-2] if v != 0]
    # The horizontal color bar is repeated on the last three rows.
    if not colors:
        colors = [v for v in grid[-3] if v != 0]
    pts = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid[:-3]) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    r0,r1=min(r for r,c in pts),max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0,c1=min(c for r,c in pts),max(c for r,c in pts)
    shape=[[(grid[r][c] == 1) for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    start=(h-len(shape)*len(colors))//2
    for i,color in enumerate(colors):
        for dr,row in enumerate(shape):
            for dc,on in enumerate(row):
                if on: out[start+i*len(shape)+dr][c0+dc]=color
    return out
